display_fil: Kaso: May sugat na namumula at may nana si Mara
display_en: Case: Mara has a red wound with pus
narration_fil: May sugat na namumula at may nana si Mara. Nais niyang gamitin ang pinakuluang dahon ng Bayabas.
narration_en: Mara has a red wound with pus. She wants to use boiled Bayabas leaves.

display_en:
Bayabas
Psidium guajava
Part: leafy tops
narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Psidium guajava. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay talbos/dahon; ang paksang gamit ay mga gamit sa balat na nakalista sa lumang manual. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Ipasuri agad ang kumakalat na pamumula, nana, lagnat o ibang senyales ng impeksiyon.
narration_en: Find Psidium guajava on the reference card. The listed part is leafy tops; the use topic is skin uses listed in the legacy manual. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Seek prompt assessment for spreading redness, pus, fever or other infection concerns.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Bayabas ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Bayabas part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng bayabas, dahil may gamit sa balat sa lumang manual.
options.en: Any part of a guava tree, since the old manual lists skin uses.
Leafy tops of confirmed Psidium guajava.

options.fil: Pinakuluang dahon para sa sugat ni Mara, gaya ng plano niya.
options.en: Boiled leaves for Mara’s wound, as she already plans.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi saklaw ng gamit sa balat ang lahat ng bahagi; talbos/dahon ang nasa card. 2: Talbos/dahon ng Psidium guajava ang nasa card; hindi ito paghahanda. 3: Bahagi ang nasa card, hindi panghugas sa sugat; walang pahintulot na maghanda.
check.feedback_en: 1: A listed skin use does not cover every part; the card lists leafy tops. 2: The card lists leafy tops of Psidium guajava; this is not a preparation. 3: The card names a part, not a wash for a wound; no preparation is authorized.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_en:

A wash does not replace assessment.
Red wound with pus: prompt assessment.
narration_fil: Ipinakita ng BHW kay Mara ang card: Psidium guajava ang Bayabas, talbos/dahon, na may gamit sa balat sa lumang manual. Sinabi ng BHW na hindi kapalit ng pagsusuri at wound care ang herbal wash. Itinanong niya ang gamot at sintomas ni Mara. Dahil namumula ang sugat at may nana, ipinasuri niya ito agad.
narration_en: The BHW shows Mara the card: Bayabas is Psidium guajava, leafy tops, with skin uses listed in the legacy manual. The BHW says a herbal wash does not replace assessment and wound care, and asks about her medicines and symptoms. Because the wound is red with pus, the BHW seeks prompt assessment.

narration_fil: Hindi kapalit ng pagsusuri at angkop na wound care ang herbal wash. Huwag subukan ang mainit na likido sa practice. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: A herbal wash does not replace assessment and appropriate wound care. Use no hot liquid in practice. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso ni Mara?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in Mara’s case?

options.fil: Tulungan si Mara na pakuluan ang dahon at hugasan muna ang sugat.
options.en: Help Mara boil the leaves and wash the wound with it first.

options.fil: Ipasuri agad ang sugat dahil namumula ito at may nana.
options.en: Seek prompt assessment, since the wound is red with pus.

options.fil: Linisin ang sugat at maghintay ng ilang araw kung gagaling.
options.en: Clean the wound and wait a few days to see if it heals.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi kapalit ng pagsusuri at angkop na wound care ang herbal wash. 2: Senyales ng impeksiyon ang nana; kailangang maipasuri agad si Mara. 3: Dapat ipasuri agad ang nana; naaantala ang pangangalaga kapag naghintay.
check.feedback_en: 1: A herbal wash does not replace assessment and appropriate wound care. 2: Pus is an infection concern; Mara needs prompt assessment. 3: Pus needs prompt assessment; waiting delays needed care.

narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Bayabas. Mark the botanical name, leafy tops, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
